system.description:
The dead do not release what they hold. Infusing her grip with the immovable finality of death, the Abyssal supplements a grapple initiation or hold maintenance with supernatural tenacity that no living strength can overcome. The supplemented grapple roll adds the Abyssal's Essence in automatic successes, and any attempt to break free of the resulting hold is made at a penalty equal to the Abyssal's Essence, as the grip carries the weight of inevitable ending.

A target caught in this grasp feels the chill of the grave seeping through the Abyssal's touch, and must succeed on a Valor roll at difficulty 2 each tick or lose a die from their break-free attempt from the soul-deep terror of being held by death made manifest. This charm serves as prerequisite for the Inescapable Iron Grip, which escalates the supernatural hold to a level that truly cannot be escaped by any mundane means.
